captions.detailed: This 3D model is a flat, circular washer with a concentric center hole. It has a uniform thickness and smooth, vertical outer and inner walls. The proportions represent a standard mechanical washer used to distribute the load of a threaded fastener.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric washer generator in OpenSCAD that can produce standard 'M' size washers or custom-dimensioned washers. It should allow users to specify the inner diameter, outer diameter, height, and tolerance, and support generating a grid array of multiple washers for efficient batch printing.
captions.factory: The script uses a custom 'washer_gen' module which performs a difference operation between an outer cylinder and an inner cylinder to create the washer shape. It integrates the 'writecylinder' helper to engrave text on the surface. A 'washer_array_gen' module uses nested for-loops to translate and duplicate the washer into a grid pattern based on customizable width and depth counts.
